title: Native independent-autocommit envelope
impact: Moonshot: A private native loop tried to execute homogeneous coalesced writes in one FFI call while preserving every member as an independent autocommit. The public insert gate improved 17.7% in one process order but only 3.6% in reverse, below the predeclared 10% bar, while the integer-only no-op diagnostic regressed 17.7% / 13.9%. Whole-group parameter/result materialization outweighed the removed call boundaries without removing N SQLite commits. Safety review also found reset-time commit-error, dirty-union timing, packed-BLOB memory, and binding-lifetime hazards. Runtime reverted; exact prototype and harness at archive/exp-257.
